cancellation-policy.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation-policy.html:
All ABoard VA

Booking, Cancellation & Refund Policies

Effective date: 09-18-2025

We understand that plans can change. This policy ensures fairness to all our guests while allowing us to prepare the best possible experience for you.

Quick summary

  • Wine Tours:
    • 48+ hrs before start → modify/cancel no penalty
    • 48–24 hrs → $50 per person cancellation fee
    • <24 hrs / no-show → no refund

  • Charcuterie Orders:
    • 48+ hrs before pickup/delivery → no penalty
    • 48–24 hrs → $50 flat cancellation fee
    • <24 hrs / no-show → no refund

  • Tasting fees: pass-through (no markup); non-refundable once remitted or inside 48 hrs of tour

  • How to cancel: use the Change or Cancel Tour link in your confirmation email

1) Scope

These policies apply to wine tours and charcuterie orders sold by All ABoard VA (“we,” “our”). By booking, you agree to these terms.

2) Booking & Payment

  • Payment is collected at booking. Your confirmation email includes a Change or Cancel Tour link to manage your reservation.

  • We may securely retain a card on file (via our processor) for permitted pass-through charges (see §4 and §6).

3) Tour Capacity

  • Public tours: shared group experience; select the number of seats (up to 10).

  • Private tours: one private party (no seat picker). Minimum 6 guests, maximum 10.

4) Winery Tasting Fees (pass-through)

  • Tasting fees are not included in tour price.

  • After itinerary is finalized, we charge your card on file for tasting fees as a pass-through (no markup), either before your tour or day-of, and we pay wineries on your behalf.

  • Once remitted—or inside 24 hours of your tour—tasting fees are non-refundable.

5) Wine Tour Cancellations & Refunds

  • 48+ hours before tour start: modify or cancel without penalty.

  • 48–24 hours: $50 per person cancellation fee.

  • <24 hours / no-show: non-refundable.

Refunds are returned to the original payment method; banks typically post within 5–7 business days. Modifications are subject to availability.

6) Party Size Changes (Private tours)

  • Our Private Tour is a flat rate for the whole vehicle (up to 10 guests). You’re welcome to bring fewer than 10, but the price doesn’t change. (Please share your final headcount 72 hours in advance so we can prep accordingly.)

7) Charcuterie & Snacks

  • Public & Private Tours: On-the-go boxes are per person—select quantity at checkout.

  • Charcuterie cancellation:
    • 48+ hours before pickup/delivery → no penalty
    • 48–24 hours → $50 flat cancellation fee
    • <24 hours / no-show → non-refundable

8) Pickup & Timing

  • Pickup windows vary by region; your confirmation and Getting Ready email list the exact window.

  • Charlottesville: pickup 8:30–9:15 AM; drop-off 7:30–8:15 PM at the same location.

  • Please arrive on time; late arrival may shorten your itinerary.

9) Weather & Force Majeure

Tours run rain or shine. If severe conditions or circumstances beyond our control require cancellation, you may reschedule or receive a full refund of tour fees (tasting-fee handling depends on winery policies).

10) Waivers & Eligibility

All required waivers must be completed before participating in any tour or receiving any charcuterie order. We reserve the right to cancel your booking without refund if waivers are not completed in full prior to the scheduled start time. Guests must be 21+ with government-issued photo ID for tastings.

11) Conduct & Safety

We reserve the right to refuse service or end a tour for unsafe or disruptive behavior (no refund).

12) How to Cancel or Modify

  • Use the “Change or Cancel Tour” link in your confirmation/reminder emails (fastest).

  • Or contact us: info.allaboardva@gmail.com (or use our Contact form).

Contact

All ABoard VA
info.allaboardva@gmail.com • www.allaboardva.com

tasting-fee-policy.title: Tasting Fee Policy
tasting-fee-policy.html:
Tasting Fee Authorization and Cancellation Policy

Effective Date: August 11, 2025

By booking a tour with All A Board VA, you agree to the following terms regarding winery tasting fees:

  1. Authorization to Charge
    By confirming your booking and providing your credit or debit card information, you authorize All A Board VA to charge the card on file for winery tasting fees after your tour itinerary has been confirmed.

  2. Timing of Charges
    Tasting fees will be billed in advance of the scheduled tour date, after your itinerary is confirmed.

    Because tasting fees are collected on behalf of the wineries, they are considered a pass-through expense and are not subject to additional tax from All ABoard VA. The total amount will vary depending on the wineries included in your itinerary and will be charged to the card on file in advance of your tour date.

  3. Refund Policy
    Tasting fees are non-refundable if cancellation occurs within forty-eight (48) hours of the scheduled tour start time, regardless of the reason for cancellation.

  4. Acknowledgement of Fees
    You will be provided with a written or emailed summary of your confirmed wineries and the applicable tasting fees prior to billing. By proceeding with your booking, you acknowledge that these tasting fees are separate from the tour price and payable in full before the tour date.

Questions?
If you have any questions about this policy, please contact us at:

Wine & Excursion Tour Waiver and Release of Liability

Company Name: ALL ABOARD VA, LLC

1. Tour Details

I, the undersigned participant, understand that ALL ABOARD VA, LLC will provide ground transportation from our agreed pickup point through a series of third‑party venues (wineries, restaurants, farms, performance venues) and return me to the original pickup location between approximately 8-10 AM and 6-8 PM.

2. Assumption of Risk

Assumption of Risk

I, the undersigned participant, acknowledge and accept that participation in a wine tour involves inherent risks, including but not limited to:

  • Transportation in a vehicle operated by ALL ABOARD VA, LLC

  • Visits to wineries, restaurants, or other locations

  • Walking on uneven terrain, stairs, gravel, or slippery surfaces

  • Theft, loss, or damage to personal property

  • Consumption of alcoholic beverages at third‑party establishments

  • Potential changes in itinerary (e.g. special stops)

I voluntarily assume all such risks, whether known or unknown.  I voluntarily assume all such risks, whether known or unknown, and agree that ALL ABOARD VA, LLC is not responsible for injuries, accidents, or damages that occur during or after the tour.

3. Release of Liability

On behalf of myself, my heirs, executors, and assigns, I hereby RELEASE, WAIVE, DISCHARGE and COVENANT NOT TO SUE ALL ABOARD VA, LLC, its owners, employees, affiliates, and representatives (“Released Parties”) from any and all claims, expenses, or liabilities for any loss, damage, injury, or expense, including death, that I may suffer, arising out of or in any way connected with my participation in the tour, even if caused by the negligence of the Released Parties, including:

  • Injuries or damages sustained during the tour (including while inside or outside the vehicle).

  • Actions taken by third-party businesses, including wineries, restaurants, or other locations visited.

  • Incidents occurring after I am dropped off at a designated or alternate location.

I understand that ALL ABOARD VA, LLC does not own or control the wineries, restaurants, or other locations visited and is not responsible for their safety, service, or policies.

4. Alcohol Responsibility & Indemnification

I certify that I am at least 21 years of age and legally allowed to consume alcohol, and will abide by all applicable laws and venue rules regarding alcohol consumption. I acknowledge that alcohol consumption is entirely voluntary, and I assume full responsibility for my actions and behavior.  I will drink responsibly and not in excess. I further AGREE TO INDEMNIFY AND HOLD HARMLESS the Released Parties from any claims, causes of action, injuries, damages, losses, legal consequences, or expenses (including attorney’s fees) arising from my own alcohol consumption and alcohol‑related behavior.  I agree not to operate a vehicle under the influence after the tour and understand that alternative transportation options (such as taxis or rideshare services) are available.  I will not hold the Released Parties liable for any actions I take after the tour ends.

5. Cleaning & Damage

Client agrees to return the vehicle in substantially the same condition as received, normal wear excepted. Excessive cleaning (e.g., trash/spills, sticky residue) is charged at $150. Biohazard/soil events (vomit, urine, blood or other bodily fluids) incur a $500 minimum cleaning fee. Damage repair is billed at actual cost of parts and labor plus a $150 administrative fee, and any vehicle downtime required for repair may be billed at $125/hour. Client authorizes Carrier to charge the card on file for these amounts upon notice with photo documentation.

6. Hold Harmless Clause

I promise not to claim against or sue the Released Parties for any injury, loss, or damage to person or property, however caused, including any negligent act or omission by the Released Parties. I agree to DEFEND, INDEMNIFY, AND HOLD HARMLESS the Released Parties from and against any and all claims, demands, damages, lawsuits or liabilities brought by third parties arising from:

  • My participation in the tour.

7. Medical Emergencies & Personal Belongings

  • I understand that ALL ABOARD VA, LLC is not responsible for lost or stolen items.

  • I authorize ALL ABOARD VA, LLC to seek medical assistance if necessary, but I am responsible for any medical costs incurred.
